test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the country that does NOT possess nuclear weapons.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nuclear Weapon Free Zone**

 
 
• The** United Nations defines a nuclear-weapon-free zone (NWFZ) **as a free agreement reached by a group of states through a treaty or convention.
 
• It **forbids the development, production, control, possession, testing, stationing, or transportation of nuclear weapons **in a specific area.
 
• The NWFZ must also have mechanisms for** verification and control** to ensure that its obligations are upheld, and it must be recognised as such by the General Assembly of the UN.
 
• Although most nations, including **five nuclear-armed states**, are parties to the **Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons**, NWFZs serve a different purpose.
 
• **South Korea and Japan** are American allies that do not possess nuclear weapons.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Another phrase,** "nuclear-free zone," refers to a place where nuclear energy and nuclear weapons are prohibited**, as well as occasionally nuclear waste and nuclear propulsion. 
 
• Countries or smaller regions that have prohibited nuclear weapons purely through their own laws, such as **Austria with the Atomsperrgesetz in 1999, are not included in the NWFZ definition**.
 
• In a similar vein, the **2+4 Treaty**, which brought about **German reunification, prohibited nuclear weapons in the new states of Germany** (Berlin and former East Germany).
 
• **Pakistan and India** are nuclear-armed states.
